title: Runner beans and halloumi with crushed potatoes

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain staple; tinned chickpeas and halloumi are both fine.

supermarket.reason: New potatoes, runner beans, halloumi, chickpeas and cherry tomatoes are everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a pan, a frying pan and a masher, and the boiling and frying are simple.

works.reason: 750g potatoes, 400g beans, a block of halloumi and a tin of chickpeas make a sound dinner for four, with clear timings and enough seasoning from the lemon, mint and paprika.

honest_times.reason: Thirty minutes covers stringing and slicing the beans, the other chopping and the frying, and the 15 minute cook matches the potato boil, though the step allows up to 20.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used and names match their ids, though step 3 says '1 tsp paprika' where the list gives smoked paprika and would read better matched.

seasonal_feel.reason: Runner beans are at their peak in early August and are the main vegetable of this warm-weather pan fry.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a balanced plate of potatoes, beans, chickpeas, tomatoes and halloumi that a family would happily eat again.
